audited.archiveFormat: One gzip JSON line per batch, holding the full final persisted item with its original serialized SHA-256, the typed source/work/version identifiers, destination identity and terminal control. No live lease token is present.
checks: complete manifest SHA links to control/target/done and to every ordinal
all terminal on generation/attempt 1, all leases and names released
frozen work/version asset, project, SHA-256, actual size, file URL and recomputed sealed admission fingerprint
actual APFS target and final file UUID/inode/nanosecond birth from held fd, file SHA-256 and length
only expected final relative names, no retained stage
all warm and timed per-source→delivery mappings equal across arms within each of the two datasets

buildIsolation.methods: Two privately linked macOS optimized WMO Core objects, recompiled from identical core files except LibraryStore+Editing.swift. Identical compiled app entry, shared benchmark harness object and copied Batch30 sealed image, catalog and photo-export runtimes. No current candidate image work is covered.

result.feature: 035 / B31 / normal 032 workbench neutral freeze in one established read transaction

assertions: held reader + separate writer remove/readmit with changed real admission timestamp
contradictory asset primary key, project, availability, byte count and hash rejected on normal and snapshot paths
legacy nil catalog hash accepts independently verified source and actual admission

inputs.main: 032 generated 200 distinct 4000×2666 JPEG inputs and 20 generated 2400×1600 RGGB DNGs.
inputs.secondary: 200 distinct 2048×1365 JPEG files from the same scenes, already exported by Batch29. Twenty new 2400×1600 RGGB DNG payloads use a deterministic stripe pattern with an ordinal-specific row change and the 032 TIFF header.

method.clock: Each arm process warms, times one sample of each of 5 groups, joins shutdown, then runs VACUUM INTO on that very LibraryStore to preserve the frozen manifests/tickets for all 10 batches. Time to first reported completed file and total workbench submission wall time.
method.configuration: JPEG 0.9, plain layout, no GPS, original neutral version, maximum long edge 2048, default benchmark exporter settings
method.execution: Main A/B/B/A and alternate B/A/A/B were serial in a reserved native slot. A short read-only fixture search occurred during the main sequence. No competing image benchmark was run.
method.scope: Two measured samples per arm per group. This is not P95 or an across-machine throughput estimate. Historical main 4.795 s total/0.082 s first for 200 remains faster.
method.sizes: JPEG 1,20,200; uncompressed DNG 1,20. Every output is a JPEG. A is the original double lookup and B is snapshot reuse.

production.policy: Only two completed reads in the same locked main read transaction may supply the proof. No callback, write, global cache or cross-invocation reuse. Public source validation and standalone captures independently reload the current asset and sealed admission.

sqlTrace.observer: sqlite3_trace_v2(SQLITE_TRACE_STMT) on the same store.db while calling the real public entry point on 200 admitted sources
